name: King St Tattoo
niche: tattoo studio (traditional, Japanese, color, black and grey)
address: 917 King St, Jacksonville, FL 32205, United States
has_own_site_evidence: Google Business Profile shows no website field (maps_discover.py returned website: null). WebSearch for the business name plus 'email contact' found only a third-party directory (tattooed.co, no email/phone listed) and an unrelated different business with a similar name in Cocoa, FL, which was explicitly excluded as a mismatch.
email_search_note: No public email found. Checked: Google Business Profile (phone only), WebSearch for the business name plus contact terms, and third-party tattoo directories (none listed an email). Phone is the only confirmed public contact channel; outreach registered as pending_manual.

services.source: Derived from verbatim Google reviews naming specific artists and from the business's own Google photos spanning American traditional (bulldog, skull and crossbones), Japanese (koi, dragon, lotus) and black and grey (botanical, skeleton fairy) styles. Nothing invented.
services.pricing_note: No price list found publicly. Site uses the adapted variant: every piece is quoted, call for a price, nothing invented.

reviews_verbatim.name: Kazz
reviews_verbatim.text: I had an amazing experience getting my tattoo done by Andy. He did a phenomenal job on the linework and made the whole process feel easy and comfortable. Andy is super friendly, personable, and genuinely funny, the kind of artist who makes...

reviews_verbatim.name: Dustin Spegal
reviews_verbatim.text: Love this shop. Love Ryan and Andy. Ryan is incredibly talented and really listens. First saw him on a whim to get a piece on my forearm and the work was so incredibly detailed I commissioned him to do a 3/4 sleeve on my other arm...

reviews_verbatim.name: O'Connor Farms
reviews_verbatim.text: I adore this shop and the artists there feel like family. The art is stellar, not a single slack artist in the building. I miss Chris being there, may he rest in peace. King Street Tattoo is my absolute go to...

reviews_note: 3 real verbatim Google reviews (truncated at Google's own preview length) out of 170 total, collected via scripts/maps_research.py. Named artists Ryan and Andy confirmed directly from 2 reviews; a third review respectfully references a late artist, Chris, which was kept verbatim as part of the real review text.
